experiments.name: Reference-oracle correction and retest
experiments.command: Initial precise-engine differential followed by integer-oracle cross-check and retest
experiments.output: Initial run: FAIL differential: 4/12 cases, 6070 SQL statements, 16 query mismatches. The 16 mismatches were large-probe false ties in the double reference; for q=1e30 and points 2,1,0,-1 the old double subtraction produced the same distance. Independent Fraction cross-check confirms strictly ordered true distances. After replacing only the reference ORDER BY key with arbitrary-precision squared distances, both binaries passed all 6070 SQL without relaxing assertions or output tolerances.
experiments.conclusion: Agent-identified oracle limitation, not student-authored explanation; failed log retained and not represented as a passing run.

retrospective.summary: The implementation prioritizes the functional admission gate. Commit records are durable before success is returned, incomplete tails are truncated, and visible state is reconstructed only from committed transactions. Exact vector search avoids ANN recall risk. This round added measured parsing/serialization/scan/filter optimizations, query preparation, and exact near-tie comparisons. Independent review detected scalar/SIMD mixed-magnitude ordering differences, then arbitrary-precision checks exposed a float64 reference-oracle limitation. Test assertions were strengthened rather than skipped. Formal Linux resource and hidden-case evaluation remains outstanding.

limitations: The official hidden MySQL cases and complete test driver were not public at the time of this record.
A local Docker daemon was unavailable, so the Dockerfile was build-step reviewed and the same source was built with CMake, but docker build itself was not executed.
The benchmark values come from a Windows development host rather than the official Linux cgroup v2 evaluator.
The student author should add further original explanations, counterexamples, and experimental decisions as the work continues; this file does not invent such evidence.
ARIS experiment-audit/result-to-claim reviewer MCP was unavailable (REVIEW_UNAVAILABLE); same-model subagents did not constitute formal cross-model audit.
Performance reports are local serial request/response comparisons, not official E or rank. Windows process I/O includes pipes and is not physical disk I/O; row-cache size is not total memory.
No student-authored technical explanation, result interpretation or transfer claim has been invented. Listed agent results do not alone establish student learning.
